Direct GPU, 18-scenario model stress, affected rows, two full matrices, default, held-out, source-derived, profiler, curated-artifact, and 112-test gates are green with backend proof and zero failed measured elements.
Claims point to immutable result/attempt JSON and the exact implementation hash; startup failures, failed/reworked attempts, dirty Git state, and absent commit/push authorization remain explicit.

The win is highly shape- and GPU-specific, automatic dispatch is deliberately overfit to one published row, forced width-eight correctness evidence is broader than performance evidence, and strict comparison passes with nonzero absolute error.
